newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Dairy Brands clarifies tax position.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Brands clarifies tax position.

text.p: Dairy Brands Ltd said on Friday it is engaged in the process of placing the 52 percent shareholding held by Apple Fields and associated interests with a new shareholder.
The company received clarification of its tax position with the Inland Revenue Department and this information was being made available before its half yearly announcement due next month.
Dairy Brands has about NZ$640,000 of income tax refunds which can be used against future tax liabilities.
In addition, it has deferred expenditure deductions of about $2.9 million.
The combined effect amounts to a gross benefit of NZ$4.9 million (or a tax benefit of $1.6m) which is available to the group irrespective of changes in shareholding.
